body: As I frantically scan the empty room, my eyes land on the faint outline of an antique music box lying on a nearby pedestal. It seems out of place, and my heart skips a beat. I approach it cautiously, feeling an inexplicable pull towards the object. I reach out a trembling hand to touch the delicate cover, and as I do, I think about the warning signs: no alarm, no guards, and a music box where there should be a display case.
